Package de.neo8.jagil.gui

Class GUI

java.lang.Object
de.neo8.jagil.gui.GUI
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.bukkit.inventory.InventoryHolder
Direct Known Subclasses:
ConfirmGUI, FunctionalGui, PlayerListGUI
public class GUI extends Object implements org.bukkit.inventory.InventoryHolder
Represents a GUI. Extend this class to create your own GUI with JAGIL.

    • GUI

      public GUI(GuiTypes.DataGui gui)
      Creates a new instance of the GUI class. Use this constructor when you like to load a GUI from the GuiTypes.DataGui class. Use this constructor when you like to create a universal GUI.
      Parameters:
      gui - the GuiTypes.DataGui class to load the GUI from.

    • GUI

      Parameters:
      gui - the GuiTypes.DataGui class to load the GUI from.

    • GUI

      public GUI(net.kyori.adventure.text.Component name, int size)
